entry_item.definition: [s. oṃ = um = om]- A mystical syllable

example.definition: « nom mani padme hūm, usually translated as 'Om, Jewel in the Lotus, Hum', which accroding to a popular, but erroneous view refers to the Buddha, his Teaching and the Buddhis tClergy- Actually it is an invocation directed to Avalokitecvara, the Bodhisattva (see Bodisadu-a) of compassion. Another explanation applying to the same Bodhisattva is 'Om, the jewel Lotus, Hum'. According to Sasnkrit grammar this interpretation would apply to a female deity.

entry_item.definition: ( usually nazalized "o" ) . This mystic syllbable is the beginning of numerous tarni

example.definition: T. and S. OM MANI PADME HUM . OM Jewel in the Lotus HUM. The most frequently used tarni in the sense of a prayer, an exclamation and an apotropaeic expression. It refers to Nidyber ysegci. see arabazana.

entry_item.definition: om, aum, syllabe mystique qui désigue la triade bouddhique : bouddha, dharma et sanga.

example.definition: épithète de Djambala (divinité de la richesse et de l'abondance).
formule mystique composé par Padmapanî (Aryàvalokitêçvara bodhîsattva): o triade (bouddha, dharma et sanga) dans le lotus précieux!
